title: Same Answers as the Interpreter
kind: hazel-jit: the changes planned at Matthew Hammer and Cyrus Omar's meeting of 2026-11-13, and where each stands; work in progress
question: After the meeting of 2026-11-13, what changes to hazel-jit were planned, and how far has each come? Matthew Hammer, 2026-11-16: "please draft a WIP report for me, and publish it, with the changes we've planned for hazel-jit, and our status on those changes thus far."
measurements: The sweep: the report Test_HazelJit_Agree prints at the end of the evaluator tests in CI's log (hazelgrove/hazel, GitHub Actions), build 47's fast checks (run 43887985051, job 133371195383) and the first sweep's full tests (run 43754503317). The Witch: jit.yml's Firefox check (scripts/jit_slides.py) on GitHub's machines, one run per build, the runs named in the builds table. Node microbenchmarks and hazeljs 0.0.6 checks are not builds of the app.
builds: Numbered as in reports 050 to 052. Build 45 is fc1103900d; '45 + N' is build 45 with ticket N's change alone; build 46 is the six changes merged (59f28470c3); build 47 adds the type-hole rule (f4f969588b) and is trial/694-view-jit since 2026-11-16.
